facts.fact: EPF members can view their Member Passbook through EPFO's service on the UMANG app
facts.quote: The most popular service availed by members through UMANG App is View Member Passbook.

summary: PIB (EPFO) confirms View Member Passbook is an EPFO service on UMANG; epfo.gov.in home also links passbook.epfindia.gov.in and promotes UMANG for all EPFO services.
